tools.name: find_vehicle
tools.description: Look up a vehicle by make and model, with an optional year. Returns the engines, transmissions and drive types built that year, how many repair jobs apply, and the factory service manual links.

tools.name: repair_jobs
tools.description: List the repair and maintenance jobs that apply to a vehicle, grouped by section, with a difficulty rank from 1 (easy) to 5 (hardest). Titles only.

section.description: Optional section filter, for example Brakes or Cooling

tools.name: factory_manual_links
tools.description: Links to industry-leading factory service manuals for a year and make, and whether each one covers that year.

tools.name: recalls
tools.description: Safety recalls for a year, make and model, read live.

tools.name: complaints
tools.description: Owner complaints for a year, make and model: counts by component and the latest few.

tools.name: repair_guides
tools.description: Find our published repair and buyer guides by make, model, year or topic. Returns titles, links and short summaries.

topic.description: Optional words to match, for example timing chain

tools.name: mechanic_market
tools.description: Auto repair business counts by trade, shops per 100,000 people and mechanic pay for a US state, or a county in it. From the Census Bureau and the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

state.description: State name or two letter code

tools.name: get_access
tools.description: Make an access key for the full manual from the person's email. The first 10 steps are free, then 5 cents a step from a prepaid wallet. The key is shown once.

tools.name: full_manual
tools.description: The full manual for one year, make and model: sourced capacities, fluids, torques and intervals for each engine, and the step by step procedure for any job (tools, specs to check, steps, what to do after, cautions). Each call is one step: the first 10 are free, then 5 cents from the wallet (20 steps for $1).

key.description: The person's access key from get_access

engine.description: Optional engine, for example 2.5L or 5.3L V8

job.description: Optional job, for example front brakes, timing belt or spark plugs. Leave out for the spec sheet and the job list

confirm.description: true only after the person says yes to paying 5 cents a step from the wallet

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Free steps left, wallet balance, recent steps, and how to load the wallet.
